    'purple broad face': [(296, 197), (327, 177), (348, 206), (317, 226)],

source_top = np.array(measurements['purple top']['surfaces_in_arm_bases']['left']['center_m'])
destination_top = np.array(measurements['orange top']['surfaces_in_arm_bases']['left']['center_m'])
support = measurements['table support']['surfaces_in_arm_bases']['left']
y = np.array(bot.status()['opening_axes_base']['left'])
y[2] = 0
y /= np.linalg.norm(y)
forward = np.array([y[1], -y[0], 0.0])
view_candidates = []
for degrees in (0, 10, 15, 20, 25, 35):
    angle = np.deg2rad(degrees)
    z = np.sin(angle) * forward + np.array([0, 0, -np.cos(angle)])
    R = np.column_stack((np.cross(y, z), y, z))
    grasp = source_top - R @ np.array([0, 0, 0.004670687935444157])
    placement = grasp + np.array([
        destination_top[0] - source_top[0],
        destination_top[1] - source_top[1],
        destination_top[2] - support['center_m'][2]
    ])
    view = source_top - z * 0.05
    checks = []
    for point in (grasp, placement, view):
        checks.append(bot.plan_move(left_x=point[0], left_y=point[1], left_z=point[2], rotation={'left': R}))
    print('tilt', degrees, 'grasp/placement/view', checks)
    if all(check['reachable'] for check in checks):
        view_candidates.append((R, view))
if view_candidates:
    R, view = view_candidates[0]
    bot.move_to(left_x=view[0], left_y=view[1], left_z=view[2], rotation={'left': R})
    show(bot.observe())
else:
    finish(reason='No tested frame supports both grasp, placement and a clear noncontact inspection target. No contact attempted.', task_success=False)
